review_candidates.title: Network Security Engineer L2 - Zscalar
review_candidates.description: Job Description – Network Security L2 Engineer (NOC)Position Network Security L2 Engineer – Zscaler / NOC Experience 4–5 years Location Mhape Employment Type Full-Time Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Network Security L2 Engineer to join our Network Operations Center (NOC) team. The engineer will be responsible for 24x7 operational support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and administration of Zscaler security services , ensuring secure and reliable internet and application access for users. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Zscaler, network security, routing/switching, DNS, proxy technologies, and incident management . Key Responsibilities Monitor and manage Zscaler security services from the NOC. Provide L2 troubleshooting and operational support for Zscaler-related incidents and service requests. Troubleshoot user connectivity, internet access, application access, and security policy-related issues. Administer and troubleshoot Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) policies, including URL filtering, Cloud Firewall, SSL inspection, DNS security, and access controls. Support Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) operations, including application access and connectivity troubleshooting. Troubleshoot Zscaler Client Connector installation, connectivity, authentication, and policy-related issues. Analyze Zscaler logs and traffic information to identify the root cause of incidents. Troubleshoot integration issues involving DNS, DHCP, proxy, routing, VPN, and authentication services . Handle incidents through the ITSM platform and ensure compliance with defined SLA/OLA requirements . Perform incident investigation, escalation, and coordination with L3 teams, OEMs, ISPs, and application teams as required. Perform approved configuration changes and policy modifications based on change-management procedures. Participate in problem management, RCA, and corrective/preventive actions for recurring incidents. Monitor Zscaler service health and proactively identify potential service-impacting issues. Support Zscaler upgrades, configuration changes, and new policy deployments. Maintain operational documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-base articles. Prepare operational reports related to incidents, availability, service performance, and recurring issues. Participate in planned maintenance and 24x7 shift-based NOC operations . Required Technical Skills Zscaler Strong hands-on experience with Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) . Good understanding of Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) . Experience with Zscaler Client Connector . Knowledge of ZIA policies, URL filtering, Cloud Firewall, SSL inspection, DNS Security, and security controls. Understanding of ZPA application segmentation and access policies. Ability to troubleshoot Zscaler traffic flow and connectivity issues. Experience analyzing Zscaler logs and troubleshooting policy-related issues. Networking Strong understanding of TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and proxy concepts . Good knowledge of routing and switching fundamentals . Understanding of static routing and dynamic routing concepts. Knowledge of VPN technologies and secure remote access. Familiarity with network troubleshooting tools such as ping, traceroute, nslookup/dig, telnet, and Wireshark . NOC / Operations Experience working in a 24x7 NOC/SOC environment . Strong incident, problem, and change-management experience. Hands-on experience with ITSM/ticketing tools. Good understanding of SLA management, escalation procedures, and operational processes . Ability to perform structured troubleshooting and provide clear RCA. Preferred Certifications Zscaler Certified Administrator / Zscaler certification Cisco CCNA / CCNP Fortinet / Palo Alto / other network security certifications ITIL Foundation Soft Skills Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Good communication and customer-handling skills. Ability to work independently during critical incidents. Ability to coordinate effectively with L3 teams, OEMs, ISPs, and other stakeholders. Good documentation and reporting skills. Ability to work effectively in a shift-based NOC environment. Education Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field . Key Performance Areas Zscaler service availability and operational health Incident resolution within defined SLA Effective L2 troubleshooting and escalation Reduction of recurring incidents Quality of RCA and documentation Successful implementation of approved changes Proactive identification of security and connectivity issues :::

review_candidates.title: Ansible Automation Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Summary The Platform Engineer is responsible for the administration, maintenance, optimization, and support of the Ansible Automation Platform (AAP). This role ensures the reliability, scalability, security, and performance of the enterprise automation platform by managing containerized application deployments, platform lifecycle operations, cluster-integrated services, persistent storage, networking, and identity integrations. The Platform Engineer enables Southern Company teams to automate infrastructure and application processes efficiently by providing a stable, highly available automation platform while driving continuous improvement, governance, and adoption of automation capabilities across the IT environment. Job Requirements BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent work experience Demonstrated knowledge of enterprise automation platforms, infrastructure automation, and configuration management concepts Experience administering or supporting Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) and related automation technologies Working knowledge of container orchestration, application deployment lifecycles, and platform services Understanding of Linux operating systems, networking, storage, and identity management concepts Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code, Git-based workflows, and automation best practices Basic knowledge of security controls, privileged access management, secrets management, and compliance requirements Demonstrate strong communication and influence skills to encourage adoption of automation standards, reusable solutions, and platform best practices General knowledge of Southern Company's core business Ability to effectively organize tasks, manage multiple priorities/details, meet schedules, and deliver on customer commitments Ability to negotiate with and influence others, both internally and with vendors Ability to build relationships and work in a team atmosphere as well as work independently Ability to provide and accept feedback Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills Experience troubleshooting platform issues involving automation workflows, integrations, networking, authentication, and system performance Understanding of platform monitoring, logging, capacity management, backup, recovery, and high-availability concepts Demonstrate Southern Style: Unquestionable Trust, Superior Performance, and Total Commitment Professional oral and written communication skills Understanding of how their activities impact function budget Major Job Responsibilities Administer, configure, and maintain the Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) to provide a secure, scalable, and highly available enterprise automation service. Manage platform components including automation controllers, execution environments, automation hub content, credential management, and integrations with enterprise systems. Monitor platform health, performance, availability, and capacity to ensure reliable operation of automation services. Troubleshoot and resolve platform, automation workflow, integration, authentication, networking, and application deployment issues. Perform platform lifecycle management activities including upgrades, patching, configuration changes, and validation testing. Manage platform resources, application deployments, storage, networking, and service configurations to support automation workloads. Implement and maintain high availability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery capabilities for the automation platform. Develop, maintain, and support reusable automation content, templates, workflows, execution environments, and platform standards. Respond to and resolve incidents within defined SLAs, including participation in on-call and after-hours support rotations as needed. Develop and maintain platform documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, standards, and support guides. Perform capacity planning and provide recommendations for platform growth, performance optimization, and resource utilization. Provide technical guidance, governance, and best practices to encourage adoption of enterprise automation standards and reusable solutions.
